summary: The Data DevOps Engineer builds and maintains automated pipelines for data engineering workflows, ensuring smooth deployment, monitoring, and operation of data systems.
responsibilities: Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data pipelines and analytics
Automate deployment of big data applications and ETL/ELT workflows
Monitor data systems, pipelines, and workflows for performance and reliability
Collaborate with data engineers, platform engineers, and ML engineers
Ensure infrastructure as code (IaC) best practices are followed

education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
3–6 years of experience in DevOps or data platform operations

skills_required.name: CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI)
Experience with data engineering tools (Spark, Hadoop, Kafka)
